preparation.subject: Getting ready for your puppy pickup
bring: Your pickup confirmation and any remaining paperwork
A suitable carrier or crate and a washable towel
Any questions you would like to discuss at pickup
preparation.food: At pickup we will confirm your puppy's current food and feeding routine. Please follow the breeder-provided instructions. Final PMH food details will be added before launch.
preparation.crate: Ask us about the puppy's current crate routine and how to continue it at home. Final PMH crate guidance will be added before launch.

checkIn.subject: How is your puppy settling in?
checkIn.body: We would love to hear how things are going in your puppy's new home. Reply with an update, a picture or a favorite story. We will ask your permission before sharing anything on social media.

review.subject: Would you share your experience with PMH?
review.body: We would appreciate an honest Google review of your experience with Paw Prints on My Heart. Thank you for taking a moment to share it.
